verdict.rationale: Elicit's core product is scholarly search: semantic and keyword search over 138M+ academic papers, journal/citation filters, clinical trials search, and API/MCP access to programmatic paper search — clearly going beyond open-web search into structured scholarly and primary-source data (clinical trials, public filings, press releases via Research Agent). Community feedback corroborates it as a literature-search tool, though also raises accuracy/hallucination concerns that temper confidence in output quality rather than the search-scope claim itself. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of literature coverage/precision and confirmation of primary-source breadth beyond clinical trials and filings.
